name: Microsoft for Education Daily
tldr: Manchester pilots Microsoft 365 Copilot before every student gets it, Word flags fake headings for Insiders, and Power Pages admins get per-site sign-in controls in preview.
window: Window: the 24 hours to 05:00 AEDT, Tue 10 Nov 2026 (Sunday 8 to Monday 9 Nov in the US).
notes: A quiet Monday in the US. Manchester's student Copilot timeline is the University of Manchester's own plan (a pilot in Semester 2, 2026/27; all students from Semester 1, 2027/28), not a Microsoft product change.

Word's new heading checks are for Microsoft 365 Insiders; Power Pages sign-in controls and Azure File Sync for Arc-enabled servers are in preview; Fabric's SQL pool changes are planned (mid-December, January); the Outlook.com bounces are as reported by The Register.
Screenshots are the publishers' public pages as captured on 10 Nov 2026; copyright remains with the publishers.

post.text:
LOOK BEFORE YOU LEAP. 👀

stories.title: The University of Manchester sets its timeline for Microsoft 365 Copilot for students
stories.summary: Selected programmes pilot Microsoft 365 Copilot in Semester 2, 2026/27, and all students follow in Semester 1, 2027/28, after students and academics asked for clear guidance on AI in learning and assessment. Meanwhile, every student can already use Copilot Chat with their university account.
stories.for: University leaders, teaching staff and students

sources.outlet: The University of Manchester Student News

stories.title: Word's Accessibility Assistant now flags missing and fake headings, for Insiders
stories.summary: Accessibility Assistant in Word for Windows now flags bold text that only looks like a heading, sections that need a heading and headings split across lines, so screen reader users can jump by section. For Microsoft 365 Insiders on Version 2610 (Build 20620.20002) or later.
stories.for: Teachers making handouts and accessible documents

stories.title: Power Pages admins can allow or block each sign-in method, in preview
stories.summary: New authentication governance controls in the Power Platform admin center let admins allow or block OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, WS-Federation and OAuth 2.0, Google, Microsoft and Facebook sign-in, and local passwords, site by site. Blocks apply to live sites too, so check affected sites first.
stories.for: University IT running student, applicant or alumni portals

stories.title: Azure File Sync gets a guided setup for Arc-enabled Windows Servers, in preview
stories.summary: A guided Azure portal experience takes Arc-enabled Windows Servers from agent install and registration to syncing an Azure file share. Your servers keep serving files with a complete copy in Azure Files, and cloud tiering keeps busy files local while rarely used ones move to Azure.
stories.for: School and university IT running Windows file servers

stories.title: Microsoft study: some AI coding agents check upgrades less when they're labelled a patch
stories.summary: In almost 1,000 runs with GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Sonnet 5.5 checked a breaking upgrade in 2 of 10 runs when it was labelled a patch and 10 of 10 when labelled major; Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6.1 Terra checked every time. Across six models, unchecked merges fell from 13% (patch) to 4% (major).
stories.for: Student coders and computer science teachers

stories.title: Fabric Data Warehouse is unifying SQL pools, with changes from December
stories.summary: By mid-December 2026, stop relying on the customSQLPoolsEnabled flag; from January 2027, new workspaces start with one read-optimized SQL pool that can use 100% of compute, which can mean faster runs but more consumption. Existing workspaces keep their active settings.

stories.title: Outlook.com is reportedly bouncing some legitimate emails over SPF checks
stories.summary: The Register reports SPF validation errors (550 5.7.23) and missing-DMARC rejections since late last week; a Microsoft support moderator called it a service degradation under investigation. Microsoft's checklist: one valid SPF record listing every sender, plus DKIM and DMARC.

stories.title: Edge offers to compare similar products open in your tabs
stories.summary: When you're weighing similar products, Edge now offers a Copilot comparison alongside the page, in all Copilot markets, and the new Checkout Savings looks for a working coupon at checkout (US English only). It's on Edge for Windows and Mac, and you can turn it off in Edge Settings.

stories.title: FragPunk's Farlands opens in Global Early Access
stories.summary: Farlands is a persistent, multiplayer delivery adventure where dozens of players share a world on a five-day server cycle; cargo weight, weather and other players change every run. It's in Global Early Access on PC and console.

transcript.t: It's Tuesday, and this is the Microsoft for Education Daily.
Here's your day in Microsoft updates, in 3 minutes flat.
Look before you leap.
Manchester's students will get Microsoft 365 Copilot, after a pilot.
Selected programmes try it next semester; every student follows in 2027/28.
Why wait?
Students and academics asked for clear guidance on AI in learning and assessment first.
Meanwhile, every Manchester student can already use Copilot Chat, and their prompts aren't used to train the models.
Making handouts?
Word's Accessibility Assistant now flags bold text that only looks like a heading, for Insiders.
Real headings let screen reader users jump straight to each section.
Running student portals on Power Pages?
Admins can now allow or block each sign-in method, in preview.
Block Google, Facebook or local passwords per site; anyone still using a blocked one can't sign in.
Still running file servers?
Azure now walks you through syncing Arc-enabled ones to Azure Files, in preview.
Cloud tiering keeps busy files on the se rver and moves rarely used ones to Azure.
In calmer news, Microsoft tested AI coding agents with the same code but different version numbers.
Labelled a patch, one model checked a breaking upgrade in 2 of 10 runs; labelled major, all 10.
The fine print? From January, new Fabric workspaces get one SQL pool that can use all the compute.
Outlook.com bouncing school emails?
Microsoft's reportedly investigating; check SPF and DMARC.
After hours? Holiday shopping?
Edge now offers to compare similar products you've got open in tabs.
In US English, it'll also look for a working coupon at checkout.
On Xbox and PC, FragPunk's Farlands is in early access: deliver cargo through a changing world.
Pilot it first, check your headings, compare before you buy: look before you leap.
Zoom out, and it never stops shipping.
Some of it's shipped. The rest is on its way.
One day, all of this. Tomorrow, probably more.
You've been watching the Microsoft for Education Daily.
See you tomorrow.
